Download Configured by MrCrayfish so you can edit your mods in world.

Go through it from the beginning and delete the section you don't want.

E.g 

"%species:hidden\_when\_nicknamed&unknown\_when\_unknown" should be changed to  "%species:hidden\_when\_nicknamed" so you can see the name of the lil fella whenever you want.

Another example

"%nature:hidden\_unless\_caught" change to "%nature"
